abstract: Infantile immature teratoma located in the nasopharynx is a rare congenital tumor that is not easily removed. Three surgeries and chemotherapy for recurrence of the tumor have been performed since a male infant with a nasopharyngeal mass was born at a gestational age of 35 weeks. Extended maxillotomy combining Le Fort I osteotomy with midline palatal split was performed at 2 years and 6 months of age. Residual tumor left in the intracranial region had not increased as of 4 years of age. Careful follow-up is needed until the patient reaches adulthood.
abstract_ja: 鼻咽腔に生じた乳児未熟奇形腫は、容易には摘出できない稀な先天性腫瘍である。男児は在胎35週で鼻咽腔の腫瘤を伴って出生して以来、腫瘍の再発に対して3回の手術と化学療法を受けた。2歳6か月時に、Le Fort I型骨切り術と正中口蓋裂開を組み合わせた拡大上顎骨切り術を実施した。頭蓋内に残存した腫瘍は4歳時点で増大していなかった。患者が成人に達するまで慎重なフォローアップが必要である。
